boards.name: B3-L05 · Layers / Text locked by Hero
boards.verifiedNote: Lead 2026-10-30: lock is not inherited in the engine — a child of a locked layer can still be edited — so Layers draws no lock on the rows under a locked layer (the round-10 inherited mark, 8ccaea2f3, was reverted: it told the user something untrue). Pending the owner's answer to "should a parent lock its children?"; if yes, the mark returns together with real enforcement. Board shot on disk (shots/147-77668.png). | Prior: Lane L-B round 11, board PNG compared: the board makes a Text inside a locked Hero read-only in the Inspector — 'Text · Locked', 'Locked — unlock to edit', 'Locked by Hero', 'Show Hero in Layers', a disabled Text content field, 'Selection and copying remain available.' The engine does not lock descendants: `isLocked()` is the element's own flag and the write gate (`writableElements`) checks only that, so the Text is editable and the Inspector shows it editable (the Layers footer's 'Locked by Hero' is a label, not a gate). Building the board would make the Inspector claim a lock the engine does not enforce. Needs an owner/lead call: should an ancestor lock gate its descendants (engine change), or does the board drop 'Locked by'? | L-A: probe-compared 2026-10-30 (case layers-tree, Container locked, its child selected; board shots/147-77668.png): footer '8 layers · 1 selected · Locked by Container'. Fixed: every row under a locked layer now shows the lock (a mark, not a control — 'Locked by a parent layer'), as the board draws Eyebrow / Headline / Text / Explore. Open: the board's lock glyphs read darker (ink) than the rows' muted ones, its selected pill stops short of the lock, the canvas chip 'Locked by Hero — unlock in Layers' (canvas overlay, not built) and the inspector's 'Locked — unlock to edit · Show Hero in Layers' block (L-B).
